### Proposal Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature or improvement you are proposing.

### Motivation & Use Case

### Proposed Solution / Implementation Idea
How should this be implemented?
- [ ] New dataset curation (specify language / framework)
- [ ] System prompt / parameter adjustment
- [ ] New benchmark test case
- [ ] Fine-tuning recipe enhancement
- [ ] Tooling or IDE integration

### Alternatives Considered
